description: This file provides functions for sending, canceling, and deleting scheduled emails via SendGrid, including handling test modes and API key setup.

methods.name: assertSendgrid
methods.description: Initializes SendGrid API key if environment variables are set, otherwise logs an error.

methods.name: getBatchId
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a batch ID for email grouping, using UUID in test mode or via SendGrid API.

methods.name: sendSendgridMail
methods.description: Sends an email via SendGrid, with special handling for test mode and missing API key.

methods.name: cancelScheduledEmail
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled email using its reference ID via SendGrid API.

methods.name: deleteScheduledSend
methods.description: Deletes a scheduled email send using its reference ID via SendGrid API.
